label: VolunteerWorkspace
prompt: Make activity dates, requirements, and remaining places easy to scan. Keep own assignments, cancellation, reconfirmation, and attributed task completion readable; separate organizer attendance evidence and venue outcomes from participant signup status. Keep daisyUI theme and shared shell defaults, canonical permissions/actions, localized labels, complete forms/errors, visible keyboard focus, and responsive stacking. Apply consistently to each styled page content scope; keep page admission and the shared shell unchanged.
